independentChecks.name: boundary

independentChecks.name: defect_classification
independentChecks.details: Independent evidence disproves the idea that this acceptance review can stop at Luna's UNCLASSIFIED_RUNTIME_OR_TASK_FAILURE label. Public GitHub evidence narrows the failure window to the TASK-OSS-09 case after seed archive creation and cache-roots initialization but before .venv cache-root emission, which means one of uv sync, the uv.lock immutability check, or pytest failed. That is not enough to distinguish HARNESS_DEFECT, TASK_DEFECT, ENVIRONMENT_DEFECT, or INFRASTRUCTURE_DEFECT for the August 1, 2026 Ubuntu x86_64 runner. A low-confidence host-side macOS/aarch64 check is non-isomorphic: uv sync succeeded locally, while pytest failed locally on missing libmagic, so it cannot establish the Linux runner root cause.
